title: Release notes and changelog
prompt: Write the release notes and changelog

steps.text: Release notes are read by three audiences: customers want what changed for them, security and compliance reviewers want every control-relevant change with its evidence, and operators want migrations and breaking changes up front. The changelog is the precise record; the notes are the readable story. Both must come from the merged history, not from memory.

I'll write the 2.4.0 release from the merged history: a Keep a Changelog entry, customer-facing notes, and a security section that links each control-relevant change to its evidence. Gathering what shipped.

## [2.4.0] - 2026-11-22
### Added
- Patient intake API (`POST /v1/intake`) with field-level encryption for identifiers and a hash-chained, append-only audit log.
- Quarterly access review campaigns in the admin console with signed evidence export.
- Passkey (WebAuthn) registration and sign-in with user verification required.
- `services/checkout`: token-only checkout service; card data never reaches our servers.
- SOC 2 evidence pack builder (`bun run evidence:pack`).
- Penalty shootout mini game.
### Changed
- **Breaking:** session cookie renamed to `__Host-sid` (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax); users sign in again once after upgrade.
### Security
- Fixed session fixation on login; session ids now rotate on login, step-up and every 15 minutes.
- Fixed upload path traversal, missing size limit and stored XSS via client content type (UP-1 to UP-6).
- Request bodies are no longer logged.

## [2.3.0] - 2026-10-14

steps.text: Both drafts are back. The upgrade guide caught the one breaking change (the session cookie rename), so it goes at the top of the notes, not buried in the security section.
Regulated customers will ask for a software bill of materials with every release, so the SBOM ships alongside the notes and its hash goes in the release record.

steps.content:
# Release 2.4.0

## Highlights
- Patient intake built for HIPAA technical safeguards.
- Access reviews for privileged accounts.
- Passwordless sign-in with passkeys.
- A checkout that keeps card data out of our systems.

## Security and compliance
| Change | Control | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Hash-chained audit log | HIPAA 164.312(b), (c) | tests/audit/chain.test.ts |
| Access review campaigns | NIST AC-2(3), AC-2(7), AC-6(7) | tests/admin/access_review.test.ts |
| Session rotation, passkeys | ASVS V3, NIST 800-63B AAL2 | tests/auth/ |
| Token-only checkout | PCI DSS 3.3, 3.4, 6.4.3 | services/checkout/tests/ |
| Upload fixes UP-1..UP-6 | Threat model | docs/threat-models/file-upload.md |

## Upgrading
Run migrations 0007 to 0009, set AUDIT_FILE, PASSKEY_RP_ID and PAYMENT_PROCESSOR_ORIGIN. Users sign in again once (cookie rename).
